name: City District & Alleys
description: Wall-to-wall city: houses packed against each other with narrow alleys between them, no open ground anywhere.
palette: soot-grey plaster, weathered oak framing, wet slate cobble, moss green, dull ochre
lighting: flat overcast city daylight, deep shadow trapped in the alleys, warm lamp glow in doorways
aesthetics: Hand-painted fantasy cartography, rough painterly brushwork with visible strokes, strong dark ink outlines around every object and wall, subtle black and brown linework, restrained desaturated colour, flat orthographic projection with every object drawn as its top surface and a short soft shadow cast beside it on the floor, inked line art over watercolour and gouache, premium hand-drawn D&D virtual tabletop map, dense environmental storytelling
ground: wet slate cobblestone laid in tight courses, worn hollow along the walking lines, moss in the joints
materials: A dense fantasy city quarter seen from directly above, built solid from edge to edge with no countryside in sight. Roofless townhouses and workshops of soot-grey plaster over dark oak framing stand shoulder to shoulder, their furnished floors open to view: beds, tables, hearths, workbenches, shelves and stacked stock. Between them run narrow cobbled alleys barely wide enough for a handcart, deep in shade, with gutters down the middle, puddles standing in the hollows, moss in the joints of the stone. Barrels and crates are stacked against the house walls, a handcart is left in a passage, iron lamp brackets hang beside the doors, washing lines and drying frames span the gaps, and rubbish and broken tiles have collected in the corners.
boundary: the flat rooftops of the surrounding buildings packed edge to edge, with no way between them
